dct_description_sm: Re-measurement of surface topography at Hidden (H), Abraham (A) and Minaret (M) glaciers, with the aim of generating elevation change measurements. New measurements of surface and bed topography of (unofficially named) Bikini 2 glacier, and Superguksoak glacier. Change detection between area and surface elevation measurements of the glaciers from aerial photos from the last IPY (1958-59) and the present. Comparison of frontal retreat rates from the early 1980s to the present.
dct_title_s: Glacier data from the Torngat Mountains, Northern Labrador, Canada (2009)
